title: Zephyr: Tunnel authorization root + egress
description: Root side: send tunnel-auth POST when route via egress installed. Egress side: tunnel-auth resource, validate signature, cache authorization, check on decapsulation. Per spec 8.11.
notes: Implemented allocation-free Zephyr tunnel authorization root/egress module with canonical COSE_Sign1 alg -65537, production Schnorr48/TinyCrypt defaults, OSCORE/root/IID/route/egress binding, bounded LRU grants and monotonic replay/revocation floors, rotation/clock rollback handling, and fail-closed data-plane direction/prefix/scope enforcement. Shared-vector generator consumes tunnel_authorization.json. Validation: strict C11 warnings clean, cppcheck clean, C23 UBSan host 1/1 pass with exact Python/Rust wire parity and fail-closed boundaries; local Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 build pass and runtime 2/2 pass (PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL). No live collisions.
